item.title: What Albertans want for Valentine's Day — less fighting about household finances, survey finds
item.description: Affordability pressures and the rising cost of living are straining many Canadian relationships, according to new survey by Money Mentors. Nearly one in five Canadians who responded to the survey said they have considered breaking up with their partner at some point due to their financial situation.
